hardware_carrier.edge_binding: rising_edge(clk); no divider or enable; admission edge excluded; every subsequent edge evaluated even after a fault
hardware_carrier.atomic_snapshot: All decision facts, epoch, cycle, authenticated-verifier result, effect request, sink reservation and payload sampled together in the admitted clock domain
hardware_carrier.input_clock_domain: SYNCHRONOUS_TO_CLK; setup/hold and upstream authentication are integration obligations; asynchronous inputs forbidden without a separately verified bundled CDC adapter
hardware_carrier.epoch_admission: External authorized controller; nonzero epoch; one admission until power reset; soft reset and repeat admission latch fault
hardware_carrier.cycle_origin: Hardware count starts at zero after admission; snapshot cycle must equal hardware count; caller labels never drive the count
hardware_carrier.coverage: Separate observer counts admitted clk edges and compares previous evaluator count/pulse; counters saturate and latch BLOCK on exhaustion
hardware_carrier.faulted_cycles: Evaluation and independent edge counters continue, but no protected output can release
hardware_carrier.readback: Synchronous request with nonzero challenge nonce copies preceding completed-edge epoch/counters/fault/state/snapshot into one stable register bank; no live multiword torn reads
hardware_carrier.effect_interface: One protected registered 32-bit payload and commit strobe; sink_ready reserves unconditional consumption of the following output interval. This is not an AXI valid/ready queue and has no retry buffer.
hardware_carrier.reset_boundary: Power reset erases volatile evidence. Admission controller must retain prior epoch/fault evidence out of band and prohibit epoch reuse; V1 readback cannot attest this yet.
hardware_carrier.witness_independence: Independent sequential logic in the same clock domain; not an independent oscillator, power domain, person or physical observation
hardware_carrier.physical_completion: OPEN; simulation and generic synthesis are not placement/routing, STA, programmed bitstream or board evidence

board_acceptance.pins: Every scalar and every bit of every vector of effect_ack_board_top, exactly once; 804 explicit package pins, no defaults. This parallel boundary requires a compatible package/board; narrower board transports require a reviewed adapter.
board_acceptance.pin_source: Caller-supplied evidenced board profile; no repository part/pin numbers invented.

constraint_interfaces.AMD_XILINX/vivado: XDC pins/IO/clock/min-max delays/uncertainty; part and generic carried in build plan
constraint_interfaces.INTEL/quartus: QSF part/top/generic/pins/IO plus SDC clock/min-max delays/uncertainty

board_acceptance.build_binding: Canonical JSON SHA-256 binds exact repository/PR/HEAD/TREE, profile, challenge, top, ordered source paths and exact source bytes, constraint bytes, target part and tool identity.
board_acceptance.top_default: BOARD_BINDING_VALIDATED=false; no admission, no effect commit, zero payload, BLOCK state, no valid readback. Setting the static generic is not physical attestation or authorization.
board_acceptance.input_domain: SYNCHRONOUS_TO_CLK; asynchronous assertion of power_reset_n allowed, deassertion requires proven recovery/removal; no bundled CDC or authentication adapter implemented.
board_acceptance.artifact_binding: Distinct confined regular file paths, no symlinks, 1..67108864 bytes each, SHA-256 verified from supplied bytes. Configuration image and programmer readback use the same vendor-normalized format and must be byte-identical; vendor adapter must prove normalization/bitstream correspondence.
board_acceptance.sta_requirements: Exact target/clock, completed placement/route, zero unconstrained paths, nonnegative finite setup/hold/recovery/removal slack; summaries must be independently authenticated against vendor reports before physical acceptance.
board_acceptance.telemetry_reuse: Existing verify_readback; exact nonzero nonce/epoch/count, coherent snapshot, equal counters and no faults.
board_acceptance.attestation_boundary: Caller JSON, claimed programmer flags, artifact hashes, RTL and generic synthesis do not authenticate physical observation. No trusted board adapter is installed; this V1 interface never raises physical completion flags.
